title: Ἐκλογὴ ῥημάτων καὶ ὀνομάτων Ἀττικῶν / Ecloga (Selection of Attic Words) / «Эклога»; optional cluster with Moeris, Aelius Dionysius, Pausanias and the Antiatticist
author: Phrynichus Arabius of Bithynia
edition: E. Fischer (de Gruyter 1974; in copyright). Lobeck 1820 and Rutherford, The New Phrynichus 1881 (PD).
ru_evidence: ru.wikipedia 'Фриних' is only a disambiguation page (no grammarian). No Russian translation found.
en_evidence: The PURA Digital Encyclopedia of Atticism (atticism.eu) entries include English translations of selected glosses. Rutherford 1881 is a commentary. No complete translation found.
value: Central document of ancient language purism (Attic versus Koine) and Second Sophistic identity. Used by linguists, Koine and NT scholars, and teachers of Greek prose. Pairs with current ERC research.
ai_feasibility: medium-high: needs linguistic precision about forms; atticism.eu serves as a cross-check.
pilot_unit: Whole Ecloga, or the first 100 entries (estimate 3k words).
